reviews.t: Great and functional, but similar to very strong liquid latex
reviews.x: Pros: - fine tipped brush makes it easy to apply - a fine wing tip is easy to draw, once the product dries and hardens on the brush a bit - waterproof, smudgeproof, an accidental rub won't ruin it. a hydrogen bomb probably won't remove it.  Cons: - reminds me of strong liquid latex; sticks to itself and pulls off in pieces. it's difficult to remove without a lot of soap and makeup remover. it gets caught in my eyelashes and hurts like hell trying to pull it out. rubbing it off has been the most

I first received this product in my ipsy bag and loved it. I have monolid eyes and they are very oily making it hard to find any kind of eyeliner that stays put all day. Not only does this one stay on all day, it also is quick drying and easy to apply. I stayed away from liquid eyeliners because too many we're taking way too long to dry and would end up smudging. It's also easy to take off with makeup remover. But like I said, the biggest perk is that it stays on all day. I've had to on for 18 h

The only "waterproof" liquid liner I trust! There are so many out there, but nothing compares to this! I am a cosmetologist+train Jiujitsu= need long wearing eyeliner that will stand the force of a days work, sweat, and training!  This product is hands down, the best!

VERY waterproof, I got splashed in the face a few times in the ocean with big winged lids and it didn't budge!!! I'm so impressed. :) This is my second time buying the eyeliner, and again for some reason it's tough to open after a few uses. I found cleaning the excess off the underside of the cap helps a little. This particular one is easier to open than the last one, but probably because I've been cleaning it more. It's still worth the pickle-jar like opening experience-- I've never had a wand

Best eyeliner I have ever used. Easy to apply, applicator makes it easy to control thin or wider line above eyelid. Stays on all day and into evening. This product is definitely s "keeper" to keep in stock!!  Also love the "glitterati" option for special evening eyes!

Product itself is fine works just like a liquid eyeliner. I'm giving it 2 stars because the picture is very deceiving. It makes it look like a large bottle of liquid when in fact the stripped portion is the brush handle and the solid black end has the liquid.

reviews.t: Fantastic beauty product, a must have!
reviews.x: This product is one of my two or three must haves .  I have never used anything else since receiving it in my Birchbox as a premium sample.  Now listen. ..I don't even want black color in my eyeliner.  BUT...this product is too great not to use.  You can create a line as thin or as thick as you like, a cat's eye is a simple sweep, and if you have allergy prone eyes or just water a lot like I do...this won't budge at all! And yet,  it comes off easily with a waterproof eye makeup remover, and doe

update 02/16 This continues to be my favorite eyeliner! reviews.t: For going out this is a nice eyeliner. No racoon eyes
reviews.x: For going out this is a nice eyeliner. No racoon eyes. But for everyday use I would not recommend it unless your a liquid eye liner pro. I have long eye lashes naturally so the eyeliner gunks up in my eyelashes and its really hard to get off. I've lost some eye lashes in the past 2 wks of using this. Does look nice though when you have time to apply it properly

My favorite eyeliner now. I was always a Mac girl until I got this as a sample in my monthly Ipsy pack. Now it's all I order. It's amazing and once on does not budge. I got my coworker hooked on this product as well. It's so precise with the fine tip you really can't go wrong. BUY THIS EYELINER! You won't be sorry :)

reviews.t: I love it. Once dry it doesn't budge and comes ...
reviews.x: I have tried numerous liners that say that they are water-proof and smudge-proof and have not found anything that delivers until I tried this product.  I love it.  Once dry it doesn't budge and comes of easily with make-up remover.  I will not be going back to any other liner out on the market.

reviews.t: ... of liquid eyeliner and this is by far the best. It is so easy to use
reviews.x: I have tried dozens of liquid eyeliner and this is by far the best. It is so easy to use, and literally stays on all day. I wear it every single day, whether I'm just hanging out, going out to the bars, or swimming and it stays on no matter what! Love this stuff so much!!

This is awesome. I have very oily lids and haven't had any success with eyeliners..until now. This has been the only eyeliner that actually stays put through the ENTIRE day without ending up smudged! I never thought I'd find an eyeliner for me, but sure enough here it is.

I love this brand!  The eyeliners actually stay put, last and last, and they don't test on animals.  What else can you ask for!  If your hesitating about buying any Elizabeth Mott products, don't.  They are wonderful.

reviews.t: Very dry like I've had it for atleast 8 months
reviews.x: Seems it has already been opened and air has gotten in. Very dry like I've had it for atleast 8 months. Not happy at all. Will go back to buying my previous eyeliner.

reviews.t: it flakes off in big chunks that get caught in ...
reviews.x: it flakes off in big chunks that get caught in my eyelashes after just a few hours of wearing it! horrible

This eyeliner will stay on your face for a LONG time. I first got the glitterati from my ipsy bag, which was amazing if it weren't for the sparkly glittery look. When that ran out, I tried a few other eyeliners but none ever performed as well as the You're So FINE eyeliner. This time I got the black eyeliner, and it's absolutely the best! It stays on all day, all night, and even the following morning (woops)! The color is a bold, glossy, black. It is easy to remove, as it "peels" off whe

This is a great eyeliner! I first received this eyeliner from a makeup subscription I used to have, I loved it so much I purchased another from amazon. I have never been great at applying eyeliner but the ease of using this one had me hooked. The brush glides smooth and evenly, the color was great and I just about never need to touch it up. My one complaint is that the liquid did get a little clumpy after two weeks which is why I gave it 4 out of 5 stars. Not sure if that is common and it's not

I just got this today.  Excited by the comments, what a disappointment.  First try:  It was a wide wet runny line.  2nd try:  Brushed the brush off the edge of the tube to get the least amount on it, again not as wide wet runny line.  Put the cap back on twisted to close it and the mascara just oozed out of the tube and ran all over the outside.  Thank goodness I ordered it thru amazon.  Its going back, with a full refund :)  I also ordered the Lorac, First try:  beautiful thin line.

I first received this item in my Ipsy bag and was reluctant to try it because I got the Glitterati color, and I don't like any glitter involved with my cat eye. I'm sad that I waited so long to use it! It is the BEST eyeliner I've probably ever used, I rarely see any of the glitter in it (so if you're looking for super glittery eyeliner you'll probably have to add more glitter to the top). I can't wait to use the plain black and I cannot see myself using anything else!

reviews.t: I think it's very easy to apply and it lasts all day
reviews.x: I got a sample of this eyeliner from an Ipsy bag and recently purchased a new one here on Amazon. I think it's very easy to apply and it lasts all day; no smudging or flaking off. It's also very easy to remove even though it's waterproof. I use a cleansing oil and I have no residue left over after cleansing.  I definitely recommend this liner. It is a little more expensive than the drugstore brands but I feel the price it worth it for what you get.

Received this eyeliner as a Birthday gift. I am disappointed in saying that it isn't a winner in my book. Unfortunately, once the liner was on my lash line/lid it seemed to separate a bit. Not what anyone wants.  If I am not using a liquid precision felt tip liner, I will say that the flexible brush tip on this particular brand is nice.  Simply put, I would expect more quality in their overall liquid product, especially with it's price tag.

reviews.t: Great brand, but a hit or miss product
reviews.x: I absolutely love this eyeliner and have been using it for years. It doesnt smudge, is actually water proof, and isnt too terrible to take off.  Unfortunately, during the past 8 months, every order I place through Amazon comes in dry and clumpy, giving it a shelf life of only a few days (compared to a few months). While I understand that it's not a reflection of the brand itself, it's really become a hassle.

Worst liquid liner I've ever had. It goes on like Bic "Wite Out" correction tape. If you try to rub or straighten it at the corners of your eyes while applying it, the whole mess peels right off. I've never seen anything like it. It did not stay on for me, either. Any amount of moisture (I'm an Oregonian, it's inevitable here), and the "strip" of eyeliner slides around on your eyelid. Ugh.

reviews.t: I liked this eyeliner mainly because it is cruelty free
reviews.x: I liked this eyeliner mainly because it is cruelty free. It stays a long time and makes nice opaque lines. I'm giving it a 3 because of how it turns to like rubber when it dries and the first time I tried to take it off it was stuck on my lashes and I pulled a couple lashes off in the process of peeling off the rubber. Maybe if you have some fancy makeup remover you're good, but I just use safflower oil.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the eyeliner for staying on all day and being waterproof and smudgeproof, even through sweat, swimming, and oily lids.
Many reviewers find it easy to apply, with a fine tip that allows precise thin or thick lines.
Several reviewers mention discovering the product through a subscription sample (Ipsy, Birchbox) and becoming repeat buyers.
A few reviewers report negative issues: the product drying out, gunking up in lashes, or being hard to open.
One reviewer complains that the product picture is deceiving about the actual size.
